title: Antarctica ice mass change: losing vs a recent gain (billion tons/year)

source.name: Antarctic Ice Mass Loss, GRACE/GRACE-FO satellite gravimetry

notes: NASA reports Antarctica losing an average 157 billion tons/year from 2011-2020, then gaining back an average 119 billion tons/year from 2021-2023 due to a run of heavy snowfall years -- described by NASA scientists as noise on top of the longer-term decline, not a reversal of it.
